title: Russian Drone Swarm Sets Zaporizhzhia Shopping Center Ablaze
detail: Russian forces launched a coordinated overnight swarm of roughly 92 Shahed-type attack drones along with Gerbera and Parody decoy drones at Zaporizhzhia, striking the City Mall shopping center in the early hours of September 7. Regional Defense Council co-head Ivan Fedorov said the strike sparked six separate fires covering about 700 square meters; no casualties were reported, though the mall was heavily damaged and expected to remain closed through the end of September.

media.caption: The City Mall shopping center burns in Zaporizhzhia after a Russian drone strike, Sept. 7, 2026

title: Russian Drone Strike Hits British American Tobacco Factory in Pryluky, Injures Bystander
detail: A Russian attack drone struck a British American Tobacco cigarette factory in Pryluky, Chernihiv Oblast, on the afternoon of September 7, sparking a fire. A local woman waiting at a nearby bus stop was injured. The strike was part of a wider overnight Russian attack that deployed roughly 92 armed drones of various models across Ukraine; police, forensic experts and emergency responders worked the scene.

media.caption: Fire at the British American Tobacco factory in Pryluky after a Russian drone strike, Sept. 7, 2026
